parsed_json.up: Select distinct IC50 activity records in nM for human Histone deacetylase 2 (CHEMBL1937). Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, then to assays on assay_id, then to target_dictionary on tid. Join compound_structures on molregno for canonical_smiles. Join compound_records on activities.record_id for compound_key. Join docs on activities.doc_id for pubmed_id_or_doi. Filter by target chembl_id CHEMBL1937 and standard_type IC50. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Do not deduplicate.
